notes.title: Play now on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36999663/c24bfc4ecda1113e1bfcc60924004a3262fffc85.png[/img]

We are pleased to announce that [b]Battle Ram[/b] is now available to play on the [b]Steam Deck[/b] as well as other controllers such as Xbox and Playstation and others.

All achievements as well as saves are automatically resaved on the Steam Deck, so you can easily continue your game even while on a plane or in other places where using a computer creates difficulties.

The controls were redesigned specifically on the Steam Deck, a hybrid AUTOAIM was added to the nearest enemy, which will help players enjoy the game to the fullest.

In case of difficulties when using the controller, you can write about it here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1262060/discussions/0/4357871368310365395/

[i]P.S please do not check the trash, yes it does delete the entire game process without confirmation. Sincerely, the Battle Ram development team.[/i]

notes.title: 2 YEARS GAME!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36999663/cd441dd35077f461860d9eeaf4f7d21ce3a792c7.png[/img]

Today, Battle Ram is 2 years old, during all this time the game has moved from a beta version of a fast-paced game to a very hardcore and challenging shooter with new levels. A fascinating journey a year later, brought the game to what the players see now, the original concept of the game remained the same, but the mechanics and new levels including opponents went through quite a few changes, thanks to everyone who has been with us all these years, thanks to you the game has become what it is eat

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1262060/Battle_Ram/

notes.title: New levels!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36999663/ce0efc7494a44a764041edfff4d7edb42b99242b.png[/img]
Hello! New levels are here! First of all, we would like to thank all the players for supporting a small indie game studio,
We thank you for supporting the Battle Ram project!

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Number of levels increased from 10 to 25!
[*] New achievements added!
[*] Enemies have new abilities!
[*] Added ability to reset levels and complete the game from the very beginning.
[/list]

[b]Corrections:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs with the game crash on windows xp.
[*] Fixed a bug with getting an achievement at levels 9 and 10.
[/list]

If you like our game, please recommend it to your friends.
If you have problems, difficulties with passing the game, please contact us: khukhrovr@gmail.com

notes.title: Save! Save! Save!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36999663/5803af65480f9a0a45271419feba02c5e58e344a.png[/img]


We listen to our community and introduce save!

Now after each level passed, the game will be saved, you will not have to start from the beginning, new levels and achievements will be added in the near future.

If you own a beta keys, you have the opportunity to check new levels right now.
